content.short: Web3 Onboard provides an open-source, framework-agnostic JavaScript library to onboard users to Web3 apps.
content.description: Web3 Onboard provides a fast, developer-friendly way to add multi-wallet and multi-chain support to your dapp. It ships with built-in modules for more than 80 hardware and software wallets, supports WAGMI workflows, and is compatible with EIP-6963, helping you save time and reduce complexity. Setup takes under five minutes and unlocks wallet connections, real-time transaction statuses, gas estimation, and a range of additional capabilities for a smoother user experience.
content.meta: Web3 Onboard is an open-source framework-agnostic JS library for onboarding to Web3. Discover Web3 Onboard and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
